report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with sub-100ms durations except one 344ms outlier; traces show every downstream span (inventory, payment, postgres, redis) completing successfully with pool size/idle=1 and memory well under limit. No error, timeout, or saturation evidence supports any taxonomy cause. Metrics show a 437ms p95 on /v1/checkout but zero 502s, so latency is not clearly faulted. Insufficient evidence to bound a root cause.
